title: Guest checkout
description: Customers can check out without creating an account, using only their email address.

title: Card payments via Stripe
description: Accept Visa and Mastercard through Stripe Elements. Payment is confirmed before the order page is shown.

title: Order confirmation email
description: Send an order confirmation email within one minute of purchase using SendGrid.

title: Apple Pay support
description: Add Apple Pay as a payment option on iOS Safari.

title: Shipping cost calculation
description: Flat-rate shipping of $5.99 for all domestic orders.

title: Promo codes
description: Customers can apply one promo code per order on the cart page.

title: Shipping address form
description: Collect the shipping address in a single free-text field.

title: Checkout analytics dashboard
description: Track funnel steps from cart to purchase in Amplitude.

title: Inventory reservation
description: Reserve stock for an order once its payment succeeds.

title: Sales tax calculation
description: Compute sales tax from a static per-state rate table.
